eliminations.note: submitted backstage -- 'I GIVE UP' -- during a crucifixion angle staged on him by Biohazard, with The Keeper assisting; a RUSH official was brought in to hear the submission.
pinned after Biohazard snapped his throat over the top rope and G.O.D. spinebustered him through a table
declared eliminated by the announce team with NO FALL COUNTED, after a sexual-assault angle staged on him backstage by four visiting characters.
pinned in the arena restaurant with the Tonga Death Grip, after Biohazard had been cut open with a glass shard
pinned in the parking lot with the Bounced Czech on the concrete, after Chris Sloboda shook his hand on an alliance and whipped him into a Hummer instead
pinned in the arena kitchen after G.O.D. drove his face into a lit frying pan twice and then hit him with it
pinned with a stereo Calyx-O Drop off the top rope by D-Kay Calyx and Jason Jameson; shown on replay rather than live
pinned at the foot of the entrance stage with a Spiffy! Elbow, after El Spiffy! hurricanrana'd him off the side onto a lighting rig
pinned after G.O.D. superfly-splashed him off a ladder through a table in the ring
pinned after Scott Cage hit a 720 corkscrew Swanton Bomb off the top rope through a table
pinned with The Wrath of G.O.D. after breaking up G.O.D.'s cover on Biohazard
pinned with McGlocklan in one fall: Biohazard held both men in a double Tonga Death Grip and drove McGlocklan down on top of him with both their shoulders to the mat
pinned with G.O.D. in the same double Tonga Death Grip fall
pinned with a Spiffy! Elbow while Brock Newbludd and Scott Cage let the cover happen
pinned with The Overdose in a simultaneous double finish with Biohazard
pinned with the Old Style DDT in the same simultaneous double finish
pinned after Brock Newbludd's Sky Twister Press off a ladder drove both men through two tables at the foot of the ramp; announced as the final elimination and the Syndicate title shot
